claim: The standard Offsite Ads fee is 15% on Attributed Orders unless the 12% fee applies.
evidence: The standard fee you will pay is 15% on Attributed Orders, unless the 12% fee applies as described below.

claim: If a shop has made sales of $10,000 or more over the prior 365 days, as calculated on the first day of the month, it pays a 12% Offsite Ads fee on Attributed Orders from the first day of the month following qualification.
evidence: your shop has made sales of $10,000 USD or more over the prior 365 days ... you will subsequently pay a fee of 12%
verifier_note: Corrected: live text adds "as calculated on the first day of the month" and that 12% applies "on the first day of the month following qualification"; page sentence that said the threshold is checked "at any time" rewritten accordingly.

claim: Shops may opt out of Offsite Ads for the duration they are under the $10,000 threshold.
evidence: unless you opt out of participation in Offsite Ads for the duration your shop is under the $10,000 USD threshold

claim: Once a shop reaches the $10,000 threshold, a prior opt-out no longer applies and the shop is required to participate.
evidence: The prior opt out while under the $10,000 USD threshold will no longer apply.
verifier_note: Verified: re-fetch confirms opted-out shops "will be required to participate" once they reach the threshold.

claim: After reaching the threshold, a shop is charged a 12% advertising fee for the lifetime of the shop.
evidence: you will still only be charged a 12% advertising fee for the lifetime of your shop.

claim: An order is attributed if a buyer clicks an Offsite Ad and places any order from the shop within 30 days of that click.
evidence: a buyer clicks on it, and then places any orders from your shop within 30 days of that click

claim: The Offsite Ads fee is a percentage of the total order amount: the displayed listing price plus shipping and gift wrapping charges.
evidence: the total order amount, which comprises the price you display for each listing ... plus the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping

claim: The total Offsite Ads fee on a single Attributed Order will not exceed $100.
evidence: the total Offsite Ads fee you'll pay on a single Attributed Order will not exceed $100 USD

claim: For US sellers, Offsite Ads fees do not apply to sales tax.
evidence: If you sell from the US, Offsite Ads fees will not apply to sales tax.

claim: Etsy charges a $0.20 listing fee for each item listed for sale on Etsy.com.
evidence: You will be charged a listing fee of $0.20 USD for each item that you list for sale on Etsy.com

claim: Etsy's transaction fee is 6.5% of the displayed listing price plus the amount charged for shipping and gift wrapping.
evidence: transaction fee of 6.5% of the price you display for each listing ... the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping

claim: The payment processing fee for sellers with a United States bank account is 3% + 0.25 USD.
The payment processing fee is assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax where applicable.
evidence: The fee amount will be assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax (if applicable).
